text:
Aisha: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — a few Qs for leadership on GTM priorities and partner handoffs.
Marc: Thanks for starting this. Can you list the top asks so we can action?
Aisha: Mostly clarification on which accounts get priority for co-sell, and whether we should change SDR/AE splits for upcoming pilot.
Tara: Ping @Leah from Partnerships for the co-sell playbook + partner enablement status.
Leah: Hey all — working on partner playbook v0.3, will share a link by EOD Monday. It will include co-sell roles + intro templates.
Diego: Quick product question — for the pilot, are we aligning by vertical or keeping regional reps? That changes our handoff doc.
Marc: Short answer: we’ll run vertical pilots for two priority verticals in Q3, but region remains default GTM this quarter. Pilot cohort announced tomorrow.
Aisha: Got it. Any changes to demo SKUs or pricing for pilot customers?
Marc: Small pilot discounts yes — finance will issue promo codes. Legal is pre-clearing the T&Cs for pilot participants.
Tara: Can someone share the handoff checklist we used last time? The one with access, demo env, and SSO items.
Aisha: I have the checklist, will post in #sales-resources after this thread.
Emma: Also can PMs get the final all-hands slide deck? Need to pull quotes for the product page.
Aisha: Uploaded the deck to the company drive: https://redwood.app/drive/allhands-apr24 (view only).
Leah: Adding a note: partner FAQ will include SLO expectations for Dedicated vs Hosted customers and compliance bullets for Private deployments.
Diego: Super helpful — Diego here would like the exact SLO numbers for the sales deck (p99 latency, uptime).
Marc: We'll publish an ops summary with concrete SLOs + acceptable ranges by Friday. That should cover p95/p99 and regional variance.
allhands-bot: Recording + transcript available: https://redwood.app/recordings/allhands-2024-04-24 :white_check_mark:
Tara: Office hours for GTM + partner Qs?
Marc: Yes — office hours Wed Apr 24 15:00 PT. Bring 1-pager asks and any account lists you want reviewed.
Leah: I'll upload the co-sell intro templates and an example intro email. Would love feedback from Sales and AE leads.
Diego: Can we get sample partner intro emails + a short one-pager that explains deployment options (Hosted/Dedicated/Private)? Sales ops needs that in the enablement pack.
Leah: Copy — adding deployment one-pager to the partner materials.
Tara: I'll consolidate account handoffs and post a canonical template in #sales-resources before the office hours.
Aisha: Thanks everyone. For tracking — can we have a single source doc for pilot signups and partner review? I can maintain a Google sheet if folks confirm.
Marc: Please do Aisha — share the sheet link and I'll add the pilot cohort.
Leah: Tagging legal & ops to review the pilot T&C and SLO language after I post the playbook.
Emma: Thanks — PMs will prepare 2 slides with impact metrics for each pilot account.
Aisha: Follow-up checklist (short):
```
- Post partner playbook link (Leah)
- Upload checklist & handoff template (Aisha/Tara)
- Publish SLO summary (Marc/Eng Ops)
- Share deck + recording (Aisha)
- Office hours Wed Apr 24 15:00 PT (Marc)
```
Aisha: I'll post the sheet link here in the morning and tag people for review. :eyes:
